picks.title: The Quieter, Harder Kind of Courage | Rabbi Alex Braver
picks.summary:
As the gates of Yom Kippur begin to close, how do we turn infinite possibility into choices about how we will actually live?



In his Ne’ilah sermon, Rabbi Alex Braver explores what courage looks like in a moment of profound uncertainty. Drawing on the Torah’s command to “choose life,” a rabbinic parable about paths that wind through thickets and clear ground, and the Israelites’ fear while waiting for Moses at Sinai, he challenges the idea that courage always means choosing quickly and decisively.



Sometimes the braver act is to resist panic, make room for uncertainty, and hold one another
picks.reason: Explores courage, choice, and living meaningfully through Torah and rabbinic teachings.

picks.title: Bekhorot 9: A Lamb for the First-Born Donkey
picks.summary: A new mishnah! When two donkeys are born at the same time, and it's not clear which one should be offered as a first-born (or a male and female and not clear which was born first). Also, the redemption of the first-born donkey with a lamb (or a kid). Note that a lamb can be used multiple times to redeem a donkey, given the proper procedure. Also, the Gemara delves into the case of designating a lamb as a possible redeemer -- with the sharp question why the owner who designates the lamb has to designate, since it will remain in his possession regardless.
picks.reason: Detailed Talmudic discussion on first-born donkey laws with ethical and ritual implications.

picks.title: 109. Regel: A Meditation of Footsteps
picks.summary:
Three times a year, the Jewish People ascended to Jerusalem in celebration of the three yearly festivals. I invite you to join me in this visualization meditation as the souls of the Jewish People meet as one as they are Oleh L'Regel, ascend by foot to the Beis Hamikdash, the Holy Temple of Jerusalem.
 
Hebrew words used in this meditation:
Beis Hamikdash - בית המקדש - the Holy Temple
Aliya L'Regel - עליה לרגל - ascension to Jerusalem for the festivals. Literally: ascension to/by foot
Chaveirim Kol Yisrael - חברים כל ישראל - All of Israel is connected
Shechina - שכינה - the Divine Presence

picks.reason: Guided meditation connecting Jewish festivals and spiritual ascent to the Temple.
